claims.claim: New players report being matched against very high level opponents, creating a steep skill gap.

citations.review_text: its an amazing game really. the gameplay is realistic, but arcade-y enough that its not boring like milsims or too overwhelming like arena games (warzone/ val/ bloodstrike). The only issue is matchmaking. from the first hour of playing pubg (me being lvl 10 ish cause my friend played a few matches before me) until my last match (lvl 34) i always get matched up against level 400-500 players. the skill gap is too big, and it takes away the fun of learning and studying the mechanics of the game. it is more rewarding, true. but not everyone play games to struggle from day 1. for ya'll that wants to try this game, go for it. best free battle royale in my opinion. but remember that it wont be kind to you at ALL. Have fun gamers!
The game gives you a tutorial but has terrible matchmaking for beginners

Playing this game for the first time in years as a humble Level 13 and immediately getting matched against Level 400s who apparently haven't touched grass since the Industrial Revolution was... an experience.

Nothing screams "welcome back" like getting vaporized by someone whose mouse probably has more mileage than my car. These people have been grinding so long I'm convinced they personally tested the beta with cave paintings.

On the bright side, PUBG gave me something valuable: perspective. No matter how bad my day is, at least I'm not spending 16 hours a day perfecting recoil patterns. If you're looking for a reason to go outside, enjoy some sunlight, and appreciate that you have a life beyond your monitor, I highly recommend playing a few matches.
Bad matchmaking, not friendly for beginners.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the learning curve as very steep and hard for new players.

citations.review_text: amazing game but really hard to learn

Still the best battle royale if you prefer realistic gunplay over building walls or futuristic jetpacks. Every win here gives you a massive adrenaline rush because the stakes are so high.

Pros: 
*Deep weapon mechanics and realistic bullet drop
*True tactical gameplay where positioning matters more than just fast aim
*Amazing experience when playing with a coordinated squad.

Cons:
*Very steep learning curve for new players
*Optimization can still be hit-or-miss sometimes
*Overall: 8 out of 10 winner winner chicken dinners.

claims.claim: Reviewers report encountering cheaters and hackers in matches, particularly within ranked modes.

citations.review_text:
It’s not just fresh accounts either—Level 500, Tier 5 players with thousands of hours are blatantly cheating with zero consequences.

Just the other day, a squad pulled up in a vehicle and threw a grenade directly at our exact location—out of dozens of buildings—without us making a single sound or giving away any info. It’s obvious ESP/Wallhack, yet because of their high level and playtime, they get a free pass and never get banned.

If you don't start banning these high-level cheaters immediately, you won't have a single legitimate player left. Fix your anti-cheat system or watch your game die.
